Create a support ticket for restaurant inquiries. 
Raises: ValueError: If the restaurant name or query is invalid.

restaurant_name.description: The name of the restaurant for which to create a ticket.

query.description: The specific inquiry or question regarding the restaurant.

ticket_id.description: ID of the created support ticket.

status.description: Current status of the support ticket.

message.description: Confirmation message indicating the ticket has been created.

tools.name: make_reservation
tools.description:
Make a reservation at the specified restaurant. 
Raises: ValueError: If the date or time is invalid or if the restaurant is fully booked.

restaurant_name.description: The name of the restaurant where the reservation is requested.

party_size.description: Number of people in the party for the reservation.

date.description: Date for the reservation in YYYY-MM-DD format.

time.description: Time for the reservation in HH:MM format.

confirmation_message.description: Message confirming the reservation details.

status.description: Status of the reservation (e.g., 'Confirmed', 'Pending').
